All Void Clouds are entangled with one another on the quantum level; it is possible that the energies animating the individual specimens are nothing but multiple instances of a singular sub-space entity.

Through careful study of one Void Cloud, we have been able to locate a number of systems that are likely to house other Clouds.

summary.text:
# 流云 / Drifting Clouds

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: common/event_chains/00_event_chains_2.txt:148 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

事件链定义 cloud_chain（common/event_chains/00_event_chains_2.txt:148）。在随游戏发行的全部文件中，没有任何脚本对它执行 begin_event_chain，也没有任何事件、特殊项目或 on_action 引用它的名称，因此玩家在正常游戏中不会看到这条事件链。

Event-chain definition cloud_chain (common/event_chains/00_event_chains_2.txt:148). In all files shipped with the game no script runs begin_event_chain for it and no event, special project or on_action mentions its name, so the chain never appears in normal play.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

日志文本“漂流的云”（所有虚空之云在量子层面纠缠…）；计数器 clouds_watched 上限5。

Log text "Drifting Clouds" (all Void Clouds are entangled on the quantum level ...); counter clouds_watched, max 5.
